name: codebase-changes help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:codebase-changes. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Close
entries.text: Takes it off the banner on every device. It stays in the log.

entries.title: Show in the banner again
entries.text: Puts a closed change back on the banner.

entries.title: Show entries as a chat log
entries.text: An expanded entry reads like the Chat viewer: what Brett said, Amber's brief, then each step, commit, PR and result. Off shows the classic facts and steps.

entries.title: Pull request
entries.text: Opens this change's pull request on GitHub.
